Test case: Verify products can be searched by entering a keyword and clicking Search.
Steps: Enter a keyword in the search box; click Search; inspect the results.
Test data: A keyword known to match products, e.g. hammer.
Expected result: Only products matching the search keyword are displayed.

Test case: Verify pressing Enter after entering a search keyword returns the same products as clicking Search.
Preconditions: Home page is open; matching products exist.
Steps: Search using the Search button and record product names; clear the search; enter the same keyword and press Enter; compare results.
Test data: A keyword known to match products.
Expected result: Both search methods return the same product names.

Test case: Verify an unmatched search displays a no-results message and no products.
Steps: Enter a unique keyword that is not expected to match any product; submit the search.
Test data: A unique unmatched keyword, e.g. zz_no_matching_product_987.
Expected result: A no-results message is displayed and no product cards are shown.

Test case: Verify clearing a search empties the search field and restores the full product list.
Preconditions: Home page is open; full product list is available.
Steps: Record the initial product count; search for a matching keyword; click Clear; verify the search field is empty and the original product list is restored.
Test data: A keyword known to match products.
Expected result: Search field is empty and the full product list is displayed again.

Test case: Verify products are sorted by price from highest to lowest.
Preconditions: Home page is open; at least two products with different prices are available.
Steps: Select price descending; read all displayed product prices; verify each price is greater than or equal to the next price.
Expected result: Displayed prices are in descending numeric order.

Test case: Verify products are sorted by name from Z to A.
Preconditions: Home page is open; at least two products are available.
Steps: Select name descending; read displayed product names; verify names are in reverse alphabetical order.
Expected result: Displayed product names are in Z-to-A order.

Test case: Verify Power Tools remain in the selected category when sorted by price descending.
Preconditions: Power Tools category is available; at least two products are listed.
Steps: Open Power Tools; select price descending; verify category heading remains visible; verify all displayed prices are descending.
Expected result: Only Power Tools products are displayed, the category remains identified, and prices are descending.

Test case: Verify a customer can enter a custom quantity on a product page and the cart reflects it.
Preconditions: An in-stock product with sufficient inventory is available; cart is empty.
Steps: Open a product; enter a custom quantity; add it to cart; inspect the cart quantity.
Test data: An in-stock product; quantity 2 (adjust if inventory is insufficient).
Expected result: Cart displays the quantity entered by the customer.

Test case: Verify changing an item's quantity in the cart updates line price, cart total, and cart icon count.
Preconditions: An in-stock product is already in the cart; sufficient inventory is available.
Steps: Change the cart quantity; verify line price, cart total, and cart icon count reflect the new quantity.
Test data: An in-stock product; change quantity from 1 to 2.
Expected result: Line price, cart total, and cart icon count update consistently with the new quantity.

Test case: Verify an eco product's line price is correct without treating the intentional cart discount as a defect.
Preconditions: An identifiable eco product is available and can be added to the cart.
Steps: Add the eco product; compare its cart line price with its unit price and quantity; do not fail the test solely because the cart total is discounted.
Expected result: Line price is correct; cart-level discount may make the cart total lower than the sum of lines.

Test case: Verify a customer can remove an item from the cart.
Preconditions: At least one item is in the cart.
Steps: Open the cart; remove an item; verify it no longer appears.
Expected result: Removed product is no longer listed in the cart.

Test case: Verify the cart displays an empty-cart message after the last item is removed.
Preconditions: Exactly one item is in the cart.
Steps: Remove the final item; inspect the cart empty state.

Test case: Verify the contact form contains first name, last name, email, subject, and message fields.
Steps: Inspect the form and verify all five required fields are present.
Expected result: All five required fields are available.

Test case: Verify submitting the contact form empty displays a validation message under each required field.
Preconditions: Contact page is open; all form fields are empty.
Steps: Click Send with every field empty; inspect validation messages under each field.
Expected result: A validation message appears under each of the five empty fields; no completed message is sent.

Test case: Verify contact form values and selected subject remain populated while the form is being completed.
Steps: Enter first name, last name, email and message; select a subject; inspect each field without clicking Send.
Test data: Test-only non-real contact details and a valid subject option.
Expected result: All entered values and selected subject remain populated. Do not submit the completed form.

Test case: Verify an out-of-stock product cannot be added to the cart.
Steps: Open the out-of-stock product; attempt to use the Add to Cart control only if the UI permits interaction; inspect cart state.
Expected result: The product cannot be added to the cart.

Test case: Verify attempting to add an out-of-stock product does not increase the cart quantity.
Preconditions: Cart has a known initial quantity; an out-of-stock product is available.
Steps: Record cart quantity; attempt to add the out-of-stock product; verify cart quantity is unchanged.
